Energy Management

Optimising Performance. Advancing Sustainability.

Driving Sustainable Facility Performance

By combining technical expertise, innovative commercial models and lifecycle support services, IAQ helps organisations optimise energy infrastructure, improve reliability and create measurable long-term value across their facilities.

The problems EFM solves.
High electricity bills
Inefficient cooling driving operating cost up year after year.
Rising carbon emissions
Compliance risk against regulation and sustainability targets.
Ageing infrastructure
Chiller plants past their best, and a capital bill to replace them.
Operational disruption
Downtime and inefficiency from poor maintenance and old systems.

District Cooling Infrastructure
How district cooling works.

Chilled water is made at one central plant and piped to every building on the network. Each building cools on it, with no chiller plant of its own.
